description: Org-wide defaults for all repos in the organization
Disable the broken IEvangelist/profanity-filter v13.4.6 lookup until its SHA-pinned GitHub Action supports Renovate-compatible version comments (IEvangelist/profanity-filter#168)
Allow version pins when Renovate cannot attach a release timestamp
Allow Docker digest updates when the registry does not provide a release timestamp
Allow GitHub tag digest updates when the datasource does not report a release timestamp
Group all actions/* GitHub Actions into a single PR

Batch renovate/renovate Docker tag updates into one PR a month, opened on the first and merged from the second; upstream ships dozens of releases a week, and automerge turns each one into its own PR. Keep the two windows disjoint and updateNotScheduled at its default, or the PR either never merges or is followed by another the same day

Keep Byte Buddy on its regular build. Every release is also published with a -jdk5 qualifier for Java 5, and Maven ordering ranks that qualifier above the plain version, so Renovate offers 1.18.15 → 1.18.15-jdk5 as an update. A dependency already on a -jdk5 build keeps receiving -jdk5 updates
Skip the release-age delay for in-house Maven libraries
Skip the release-age delay for in-house Docker images
Skip the release-age delay for in-house Go modules
Skip the release-age delay for in-house GitHub Actions/workflows
Skip the release-age delay for Go toolchain patch updates, so compiled binaries get Go security fixes as soon as they ship

Delay Go toolchain minor updates by 90 days, until linters built with an older Go can type-check the new release; Go ships security fixes for the previous minor release too; keep before the go directive rule

Raise the go directive in go.mod only to Go releases at least three years old, the usual backward-compatibility window, so consumers on older Go can still build the module; keep after the Go toolchain rules
Skip the release-age delay for official golang.org/x library updates

Compare the Alpine release in X.Y.Z-alpineA.B Docker tags as part of the version, so a tag on a newer Alpine is an update rather than an incompatible suffix; a trailing variant such as -slim must match
Compare the Alpine release in X.Y-alpineA.B Docker tags as part of the version, and keep the two-component precision
Compare the Alpine release in X-alpineA.B Docker tags as part of the version, and keep the one-component precision

Version qubership-java-base tags <java>-<os>-<version> by the image version, and keep the Java release and the OS (alpine or ubi) of the current tag; Docker versioning reads 21-alpine-2.5.0 as Java 21 and proposes 25-alpine-2.5.0

Version qubership-core-base and qubership-nginx-base tags alpine-<version> and ubi-<version>, which Docker versioning rejects as invalid; a ubi tag stays ubi, and a legacy unprefixed tag moves to alpine-<version>
Replace the legacy latest tag of qubership-core-base and qubership-nginx-base with alpine-latest
Do not delay pinning mutable references; keep last to override inherited release-age rules
